confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Bilbao and northern Spanish pricing; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel rates are least certain because July demand moves them widely; the 3-star anchor could plausibly fall between about 140 and 220 USD. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail roughly three times beer, wine glass slightly above beer) because direct knowledge is weak. USD figures reflect approximate recent euro-dollar levels, not a live quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Spanish tourism cities: Valencia and Seville for everyday prices, adjusted upward for Basque dining and July demand, and kept below San Sebastián, which is typically more expensive.
